name: Angel on the Coastal Front
source:
When Christopher is injured in a grenade explosion he wakes up in an unknown place with a single field medic caring for him. He soon finds out that not only are they the only survivors on the battlefield, but they may be the only ones on the entire island.

Angel on the Coastal Front is a kinetic BL visual novel that tells the story of two soldiers who grow close while being stranded together on a war-ravaged island.

[from [url=https://fuhero.itch.io/angel-on-the-coastal-front]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当克里斯托弗在手榴弹爆炸中受伤时，他在一个未知的地方醒来，只有一名战地医生在照顾他。他很快发现他们不仅是战场上唯一的幸存者，而且可能是整个岛上唯一的幸存者。

《海岸前线的天使》是一部动感BL视觉小说，讲述了两名士兵在被困在饱受战争蹂躏的岛屿上时逐渐亲密的故事。

[来自[url=https://fuhero.itch.io/angel-on-the-coastal-front]itch.io[/url]]
